plan.problem: The current LAB is a frozen archive list and does not expose active experiments or production tools as a place to explore.
plan.currentContract: tools/work-lifecycle.cjs generates lab/index.html from the lifecycle registry and frozen ARCHIVE.md files; --check compares exact output; frozen identity/runtime and production exclusion are protected.
plan.whyExistingIsInsufficient: The archive-only renderer cannot convey the requested seven-room institute or the relationship between active studies, tools and completed research results.
plan.design: Generate a semantic seven-room cutaway with symbolic local SVG machines; local CSS provides timber floors, light and restrained transform animation; a small optional hash script selects one room, restores selection after Back, and retains a no-JavaScript archive path. Machine URLs and lifecycle labels are resolved during generation, with existing URL existence checks. Native tools show their actual environment instead of a false Web launch.
alternativesRejected: A card dashboard does not meet the requested spatial experience
Embedding live games or adding WebGL/free walking would add weight and exceed scope
Copying lifecycle statuses or editing only generated HTML would create drift
Adding LAB return UI to individual prototypes would violate protected work scope
plan.migration: No identity, lifecycle or URL migration. Regenerate lab/index.html with the existing CLI after adding the placement/render assets.
plan.compatibility: Keep lab/, the town development link, all six frozen archive files and fragment IDs, same-tab work URLs, noindex,nofollow and a usable no-JavaScript fallback. Escape source text. Reduced-motion and narrow-view CSS are required.
